Commentary.Commentary: Right then, Australia have clinched this ODI series along with 10 more World Cup Super League points. We have one more game to go in this series and New Zealand would be hoping to end on a high and salvage some pride in that game. It will be played on Sunday, 11th of September at the same venue, Cazaly's Stadium, Cairns. It will start at 9.50 am IST (4.20 am GMT). Join us early though for the bulid-up. Till then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Mitchell Starc is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his all-round performance. He says that he feels he was too involved in the game for his liking as he would have like to see the batters do their job. Adds that it was still a very good win for the team. Claims that they knew that if they hung in there they would be able to get to a decent total. Mentions that they are a calm group and were clinical with the ball. Admits that the pitch was not easy to bat on as it was fairly slow and they bowled with discipline. Credits Sean Abbott for waiting in the wings and then coming out to bowl four maidens on the trot. Shares the credit with Adam Zampa for his fifer and Josh Hazlewood for doing Josh things.

Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand says that this was not the best effort with the bat from them and adds that Australia were brilliant and they did not apply themselves well. Says that the surface was tricky and it was not easy to chase this down and they tried to take the game deep. Tells that they need to apply themselves better and it was not the usual ODI wicket and they could have done better. Mentions that everyone has a mind of their own and makes their own decisions but they need to reflect on this loss and have some conversations. Says that there will be a new surface in the next game and they need to adjust to that surface quickly in the next game.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says that it has been a tough outing, the first 40 overs were difficult and the tail-enders showed them how to bat. Admits that they hung in there and Starc did well at the end. Credits the bowlers for being outstanding. Adds that they bowled with a lot of discipline and it is a great win. Informs that the wicket became slower as the game progressed and as the scoreboard pressure builds, it gets difficult to score runs. Claims that Adam Zampa got the rewards but the game was set up before that. Adds that they needed to be impressive in the Poweplay and that was the best chance they had, to get ahead in the game. Says that the trick is to be positive  and regardless of the position they are in, they want to come out aggressive.
Time for the Presentation...

Adam Zampa is down for a quick chat. He says that he didn’t bowl at his best in this game but he is happy to get wickets and adds that it happens sometimes. Tells that they had a tough work with the bat and the guys bowled quite well with the new ball and tells that he was not sure about the dew. Signs off by saying that it feels good to wrap up the series and win against the number 1 side in the world.

Earlier, in the game it was the late charge by Australian tail-enders that took them to close to 200 after their top order crumbled yet again against the top-class bowling of Kiwis. Mitchell Starc who scored 38 runs had handy partnerships with Zampa and Josh Hazlewood and that gave some momentum to Australia going into the break. Also, let's not forget the 61 runs Steven Smith scored when Boult and company were going great guns. Boult was the pick of the bowlers with four wickets but he and rest of the New Zealand camp will be very disappointed with how they messed up the chase with the bat.

Well, Australia have done what we have been used to seeing them doing over the years. They are known for their fighting effort when chips are down and that is exactly what we saw in this game. Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood showed great intensity with the new ball and Starc got a big wicket of Martin Guptill early which set the tone. Sean Abbott then was absolutely brilliant and took two wickets in his first over and bowled four maidens on trot to put New Zealand right on the back foot. Adam Zampa then joined the party and ended with a five-wicket haul to seal this game and series for Australia.

New Zealand would have been the happier side coming into the second half. However, the way they went about this chase was quite surprising to say the least. They lost Martin Guptill early and Conway and Tom Latham also could not last long. With three wickets down, the skipper Kane Williamson went completely in the shell. Daryl Mitchell at the other end also could not get going and after chewing up lot of deliveries, Kane Williamson departed at the score of 17 from 58 balls in which he played 47 dot balls. Once, he departed Daryl Mitchell also could not survive for long and they kept on losing wickets at regular intervals and ended up falling short by 113 runs in a chase of 196 here. The problem for the Kiwis was the lack of self belief they showed after losing three early wickets and they surely are a better batting unit than they showed in this game. Let's hope they come back stronger.

Australia take an unassailable lead of 2-0 in this three-match ODI series! They have done that with another superb bowling effort. Have to say, the bowling effort in this match by the Aussies is right up with the best bowling performances we have seen in recent times. New Zealand have been waiting for 13 years for that ODI win against Australia in Australia and they will have to continue that waiting game as they have crumbled to another loss here.

OUT! LBW! It's all over! New Zealand have been bowled out for just 82! Adam Zampa flights a googly really full and pitching on off, Trent Boult looks to sweep this one but is early into the shot. The ball goes on to hit the pads. The Aussies think it is all over and after some contemplation, the umpire finally raises his finger. Trent Boult decides to review this and why not? There is no inside edge as confirmed by Snicko and Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wicket's hitting as the ball is just clipping the leg stump. The on-field decision remains and Adam Zampa gets his five-wicket haul. What a performance this has been by the bowling unit of Australia. They win by 113 runs.
Another full toss outside off, Trent Boult looks to whip this towards the leg side but gets a leading edge that falls short of the fielder at cover.
Adam Zampa gets this in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Trent Boult looks to make room and chips the ball over the infield on the off side for a couple of runs.
Adam Zampa bowls a googly turning down leg on a fuller length, Trent Boult is well across the stumps but misses his flick and the ball hits his pads. Another appeal but the umpire says not out.

Adam Zampa flights this full and just outside off, Trent Boult gets across the stumps and looks to sweep. Misses the ball as it goes on to thud against the pads. There is an appeal but the ball is clearly missing the off stump.
FOUR! Trent Boult is out there to have some fun! Adam Zampa bowls a low full toss outside off, Trent Boult charges down the wicket and slaps the ball to the right on mid on for a boundary.
This is full and outside off, Mitchell Santner taps the ball towards backward point.
This is slightly short and outside off, Mitchell Santner goes back in the crease and punches the ball towards cover.
Flights this one full and outside off, Mitchell Santner blocks this towards cover.
This is fired into the pads on a fuller length, Trent Boult clips this towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Glenn Maxwell bowls this a touch shorter and wide outside off, Mitchell Santner cuts this towards deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Boult knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shorter and around off. Mitchell Santner punches it to covers.
Goes fuller on middle. Boult clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Adam Zampa bowls this full and well outside off, Trent Boult goes towards the ball and leaves exaggeratedly.
Adam Zampa bowls a googly outside off, Trent Boult punches this straight to mid off.
Adam Zampa bowls a low full toss in line with the stumps, Trent Boult flicks this straight to mid-wicket.
Trent Boult is the last batter for New Zealand and he makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Adam Zampa gets his fourth wicket now! Matt Henry departs now. This is tad shorter and on middle. Henry goes back and works it aerially towards mid-wicket. The substitute fielder Ashton Agar takes the catch. Can Adam Zampa take a five-wicket haul here?
Commentary.Howout: c sub Ashton Agar b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks break. Well, it has been one way traffic so far and Australia are just two wickets away now from winning this series. New Zealand stil need 124 runs and have to say, it has been a very poor batting effort from them. They went into their shell after losing couple of wickets early and  just could not gain any momentum after that. It looks like a mere formality from hereon. Let's see how quickly the Aussies go about their business now.
Tossed up, on off. Mitchell Santner drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls this quicker and straight, angling inform outside off. Mitchell Santner happy to block this out towards cover.
Full once again and pitching on an off stump line, Matt Henry hits the back to the bowler who parries it towards long off. They take a run.
Gets the ball to spin back in sharply from outside off, Matt Henry blocks the ball towards cover.
This is full as well and outside the off stump, Mitchell Santner shimmies down the wicket and mistimes his loft short of long on for a run.
Glenn Maxwell flights this full and just outside off, Matt Henry chips this towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Plays this one really late and gets four for it! Adam Zampa bowls this one full and outside the off stump, Mitchell Santner goes back in the crease and cuts this to the right of backward point for a boundary.
This is outside off on a fuller length, Mitchell Santner lunges forward and smothers the ball into the pitch.
Misses his line once again and serves this on the pads on a shorter length, Matt Henry tucks this to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Strays down leg side this time on a shorter length, Matt Henry does not get this away and is called wide by the umpire.
This is wider outside off and on a full length, Mitchell Santner hits this hard towards long off and takes one.
Adam Zampa bowls this one full and straight, Mitchell Santner blocks this solidly back down the pitch.
What a teaser from Adam Zampa! He floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Mitchell Santner goes to drive but gets an outside edge past the stumps and the keeper to third man for two runs.
This is full as well and outside the off stump, Matt Henry knocks the ball towards the point fielder.
That was close! Mitchell Starc serves this one full and just outside off, Matt Henry goes for the hoick but misses. The ball passes really close to the off pole.
Mitchell Starc fires this one full and into the stumps, Matt Henry gets his bat down in time and flicks the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Mitchell Starc goes 'round the wicket to the right-hander and serves this on a good length, outside off. Matt Henry knocks this to mid off.
This is on a good length and outside off, Mitchell Santner punches this off the back foot towards deep point for a run.
Mitchell Starc goes full and into the stumps, Mitchell Santner clips this towards the mid on fielder.
Another straighter delivery served full and outside off, Matt Henry hangs his bat out to dry and is beaten on the outside edge.
Adam Zampa floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Matt Henry blocks this back towards the bowler.
Who will be the next batter in?

OUT! BOWLED! Too good for Tim Southee this and it has really been a great bowling effort from the Aussies. This is lovely bowling by Zampa. He bowls a perfect googly that pitches around off and turns into Southee. He tries to defend it off the front foot. However, the ball sneaks between his bat and pad and shatters the stumps. Australia are just two wickets away now from sealing this series.
On the shorter side, on off. Mitchell Santner punches it to long off for a single.
A flatter one on off. Mitchell Santner punches it to covers.
A fuller delivery, outside off. Tim Southee drives it to covers for a single.

Huge appeal! Mitchell Santner bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Beats the outside edge and the Aussies think there is a nick. They do not go upstairs for this though. Another successful over for Australia.
Mitchell Starc bowls full once again and outside off, Mitchell Santner blocks this towards cover as well.
On a length, on off. Mitchell Santner blocks it off the front foot.
Mitchell Santner fires this one full and into the pads, Mitchell Santner finds the mid-wicket fielder with his flick.
Angles this one into the pads from 'round the wicket on a fuller length, Tim Southee clips the ball towards mid-wicket.
What a turnaround this has been, Aussies have been simply brilliant with the ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Starc strikes and another one bites the dust! He serves this on a fuller length and angles the ball into the stumps, Michael Bracewell looks to flick this leg side but does not connect well and the ball hits the pads. The ball lobs into the air and Glenn Maxwell at backward point comes running forward and takes a fine catch. There is a massive appeal for LBW initially but the umpire remains unmoved. As soon as the catch is taken he raises the finger. Snicko and Hotspot show a faint inside edge and Michael Bracewell walks back to the shed. Tim Southee is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot to end the over! A fuller delivery on off. Mitchell Santner drives it to covers this time.
Beaten! This is around off and tossed up. It turns a bit after pitching and beats Mitchell Santner as he tries to defend it.
On the shorter side again, around off. Michael Bracewell punches it to deep extra cover for just a single.
Tad shorter on off. Mitchell Santner punches it to deep point for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle. Michael Bracewell defends it off the inside half of his blade towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Michael Bracewell drives it to covers.
Single to end the over! On the shorter side, around off. Michael Bracewell pulls it firmly to mid-wicket. Finch drives to his left and half-stops it. Single taken.
Dot balls just keep coming, no run in this over so far. On a length and around off. Michael Bracewell is happy to defend it towards the off side.
A fullish delivery on off. Michael Bracewell drives it firmly to mid on.
Shortish length and outside off. Michael Bracewell tries to cut it but does not time it this time.
Serves it on a length, on off. Michael Bracewell punches it to mid on.
Lands it on a length, on off. Michael Bracewell defends it onto the pitch.
Good stop by Maxwell at covers. Overpitched delivery on off. Santner drives it to right of cover and Maxwell there stops it with a dive.
A flatter delivery on off. Mitchell Santner blocks it out.
FOUR! Boundary and much-needed for New Zealand! This is a flighted delivery on off. Mitchell Santner gets under it and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Bowls a nice loopy delivery on middle. Mitchell Santner gets an outside edge as he tries to defend it. The ball rolls towards the point region.
Slower through the air, on middle. Mitchell Santner blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Michael Bracewell knocks it to long on for a single.
Mitchell Santner makes his way out to the middle and New Zealand seem to be staring down a barrel now.

OUT! CAUGHT! New Zealand are crumbling here, this is a big wicket of James Neesham now! Marcus Stoinis joins the party and New Zealand are six down here with only 45 on the board. Marcus Stoinis bowls it full on middle. James Neesham flicks it but does so uppishly and ends up hitting it straight to Aaron Finch at mid-wicket. James Neesham has fallen right in the trap set by the Aussies there and they now need a special effort from hereon to win this one.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: Goes fuller on middle. James Neesham whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is on a good length and outside the off stump, James Neesham taps this towards cover.
Marcus Stoinis bangs this in short and outside the off stump, Michael Bracewell goes for the pull shot towards mid-wicket. A half-stop concedes a single.

FOUR! Crunched away! This has been beautifully played. Marcus Stoinis bowls full once again and just outside the off pole. Michael Bracewell hits this straight back past the bowler for a straight boundary.
Marcus Stoinis begins the over with a full delivery outside the off pole, Michael Bracewell strokes this firmly towards point.

NOT OUT! Adam Zampa tosses this up, on off. James Neesham tries to sweep it but misses and is rapped on the pads. Adam Zampa in hope of another wicket makes a loud appeal. However, the umpire this time says no. Australians though are pretty confident and they take the review. The Hotspot shows no bat there. However, the Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the stumps. So the original decision stays and the New Zealand camp will be relieved here.
James Neesham makes his way out to the crease and has a long way to go to finish the game for New Zealand.

OUT! LBW! Adam Zampa gets another one and things are looking quite bleak for New Zealand now. Daryl Mitchell departs and sadly for New Zealand, this chase is going nowhere at the moment for them. This is tossed up, on off. Daryl Mitchell gets across and tries to reverse-sweep it. He, however, misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a huge appeal and the umpire eventually raises his finger. Daryl Mitchell after consulting his partner takes the review but it does not make any difference as the Snicko shows no bat there and the Ball Tracking shows three reds as well. Daryl Mitchell has to take that long walk back to the pavilion.
Tad shorter on off. Daryl Mitchell punches it to covers.
Bowls it quicker and on middle. Michael Bracewell clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Michael Bracewell defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Mitchell skips down the track and clips it to long on for a single.

Quick single to end the over! Lands it on a length, on middle. Daryl Mitchell defends it towards mid on and sets off for a single. The fielder runs towards it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Single taken.
Lands it on a length, on middle. Mitchell clips it to short mid-wicket.
This is full once again and outside the off stump, Michael Bracewell gets across and strokes this to the right of mid off. They take a single in the meantime.
Marcus Stoinis goes full this time and outside the off pole, Michael Bracewell strokes this straight to mid off.
Marcus Stoinis delivers this back of a length and outside off, Michael Bracewell mistimes his pull towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Marcus Stoinis serves this on a good length and outside off, Michael Bracewell blocks this towards point.
Tossed up, around off. Daryl Mitchell defends it off the front foot.
Adam Zampa floats a googly full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell lunges forward and gets an inside edge onto his pads. the ball could have easily rolled onto the stumps.
Fires this one quicker in the air and serves this full outside off, Daryl Mitchell blocks this towards cover.
Flights this one full as well and outside off, Michael Bracewell goes for a drive but gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a single.
Adam Zampa serves this one full and in line with the stumps, Michael Bracewell flicks this towards mid-wicket.
Michael Bracewell is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! Kane Williamson's labored knock has come to an end! Adam Zampa bowls a loopy full toss in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson sees an opportunity to score runs and his eyes light up. He looks to heave this into the leg side but misses the ball altogether. The ball goes on to hit the pads right in front of the wicket and Adam Zampa runs off in celebration. The umpire raises his finger and after long consideration, Kane Williamson decides to review. Hotspot shows there is no bat involved and Ball Tracking has umpire's call on wicket's hitting. The onfield decision remains and Kane Williamson has to depart. Big wicket for the Aussies. New Zealand are going nowhere in their chase here.
Change of ends for Adam Zampa. He replaces Sean Abbott.
Marcus Stoinis bowls this full and outside the off stump, Daryl Mitchell dabs this back towards the bowler. Five runs from Marcus Stoinis' first over.

Daryl Mitchell goes for a release shot! Marcus Stoinis takes pace off once again and bowls this full and angling into the stumps, Daryl Mitchell lofts this but does not time it well as he gets beaten for pace. The ball lands just beyond the mid off fielder and they take a brace.
Slower delivery bowled full and outside the off pole, Daryl Mitchell taps this towards the short cover region.
Gets his line right this time, outside off and on a good length. Daryl Mitchell blocks this back towards the bowler.
Pulls his length back a fraction and angles this down leg, Kane Williamson helps it along the way towards fine leg and takes a single.
Marcus Stoinis begins with a good length delivery angled into the stumps, Kane Williamson uses his wrists and flicks the ball to the right of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack now. New Zealand will surely look to target him.
This is outside the off stump and on a good length, Daryl Mitchell taps the ball towards cover with soft hands. No maiden for Sean Abbott this time.

Finally a run conceded by Sean Abbott! There is a groan of dissatisfaction from the players and the crowd. He strays into the pads on a good length, Kane Williamson clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Delivers this one on a middle stump line and on a good length, Kane Williamson tucks this towards mid-wicket.
Sean Abbott bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Kane Williamson shimmies down the wicket and taps the ball towards cover.
Sean Abbott continues to bowl straight and on a good length, Kane Williamson looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge back down into the pitch.
On a good length and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson fends this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell blocks this towards short mid on.

FOUR! Daryl Mitchell finally gets one away! Just the second boundary in the New Zealand innings. Adam Zampa flights this one full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep and this time gets it to the deep backward point boundary for four runs.
Short once again and outside the off stump, Kane Williamson carves this to deep cove for a single.
Angling into the pads from a shorter length and Kane Williamson can not out this away and the ball hits his pads.
Flighted full and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell goes for the reverse sweep and gets it to the right of short fine leg. Aaron Finch puts in a dive and restricts them to a single.
Adam Zampa floats this one full and outside off, Daryl Mitchell blocks this towards cover.

DRINKS! A well-earned break for the Aussies here! They have definitely come out to fight and have had a stranglehold on the Kiwi batters. They have taken three crucial wickets and are conceding less than 2 runs per over. Kane Williamson has spent a considerable amount of time at the wicket facing several dot balls and Daryl Mitchell has gotten off to a watchful start as well. A lot will depend on them as they look to chase down what now seems like a commanding total.

Kane Williamson keeps it out again and Sean Abbott now has four maidens in his four overs along with two wickets he took in his first over! Stuff of dreams this, he continues to bowl it on a good length, close to off. There is no room for the batter to work with and Kane Williamson does not even try to make something out of nothing and just blocks it away.

Now, then this is another dot ball and will we see four maidens on a row? Lands this one on a length, on off. Kane Williamson is solid in his defence. However, is this the right way to go for the Kiwis?
Still no run scored! He has bowled 22 deliveries now! Back of a length, on off. Kane Williamson is just happy to defend it.
Bowls it touch shorter, on off. Kane Williamson rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Back of a length and outside off. Kane Williamson punches it to the point fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Kane Williamson pushes it to left of the bowler. Still no run scored off the bowling of Sean Abbott!
A full toss on middle. Kane Williamson knocks it down to long on for a single. Just 3 from the over!
Fails to beat short third man. Zampa with another delivery that is shortish and outside off. Kane Williamson late cuts it left of short third man. Finch there dives and stops it.
Bowls it short and wider outside off. Mitchell cuts it to deep point for a single.
Touch shorter again, around off. Kane Williamson punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tad shorter on middle. Kane Williamson clips it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Kane Williamson drives it off the inside half of his blade back to the bowler.
Adam Zampa has been brought into the attack.
Another maiden, this is brilliant stuff from Aussies! Serves it on a length, on off. No room for the batter to work it and Daryl defends it.
Bowls it fuller on off. Mitchell drives it to mid off this time.
Bit of inside edge this time! A fullish delivery, swinging into middle. Daryl Mitchell tries to drive it but gets the inside edge that brushes his pads and rolls towards the leg side.
Another dot delivery! Keeps it on a good length, on off. Daryl Mitchell only manages to defend it.
Goes fuller and on middle. Daryl Mitchell plays it back to the bowler.
Serves it on a length, on off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and outside off. Kane Williamson rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Kane Williamson is solid in his back foot defence this time!
In the channel, on off. Kane Williamson defends it right under his eyes.
On a good length and outside off. Kane Williamson makes a watchful leave.
Back of a length, on off. Kane Williamson rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Serves it on a length, on off. Kane Williamson defends it off the front foot.
Sean Abbott bowls this outside the off pole on a fuller length, Daryl Mitchell lunges forward and blocks the ball towards cover. Third maiden on the trot.
Beaten! A good-length delivery, outside off. Daryl Mitchell tries to drive it away. However, the ball ends up beating the outside edge of his blade.
Angles it into middle, on a length and Daryl Mitchell clips it to mid-wicket.
Serves it on a length, on middle. Daryl Mitchell defends it from his crease.

Another good delivery and there is a huge appeal for LBW! However, the umpire is not interested and Finch after thinking for a while takes the DRS! The replays roll in and the Hotspot and Snicko shows no bat there. The Ball Tracking rolls now and it shows that the impact is outside off. So, the original decision of NOT OUT stays. This one lands around off and nips back in. Daryl Mitchell tries to defend it but he misses and the ball hits him on the pads. However, it looked like the impact was outside off and the Ball tracking confirmed the same.
Lands it on a length, on middle. Daryl Mitchell clips it to short mid-wicket.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Wide this outside off on a good length, Kane Williamson feels for the ball and gets beaten all ends up. Back-to-back maidens for Australia.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson dabs this back towards the bowler.
This is wide outside off but still on a good length, Kane Williamson gets across and defends the ball towards point.
What a lovely delivery from Josh Hazlewood! Bowls this on a length and outside off, Kane Williamson pushes at this but gets beaten by the extra carry off the wicket.
On a good length and outside the off stump, Kane Williamson taps this towards the cover region.
Josh Hazlewood begins the over with a good-length delivery just outside off, Kane Williamson blocks this towards mid on.
Delivers this on a good length and outside the off stump, Daryl Mitchell leaves this one alone. A double-wicket maiden for Sean Abbott to begin his spell!
Daryl Mitchell is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in one over and Australia are right back in this game! Sean Abbott continues to tempt Tom Latham outside off on a good length. The batter obliges and pushes at the ball but gets a thick outside edge that flies to first slip. Aaron Finch takes the catch quite well and New Zealand are crumbling in this run chase. Sean Abbott has come into the attack and turned the tide in his team's favor.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: This is angling away from outside off on a good length, Tom Latham plays at this and hits it towards cover.
Sean Abbott decides to go over the wicket, bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Tom Latham gets a confident stride forward and blocks the ball down the wicket.
Tom Latham comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! What an outstanding bowling change and Sean Abbott strikes immediately! He serves this on a good length and straying down leg, Sean Abbott swivels and looks to lift this over the fine leg fielder. Does not get a good connection and the ball floats into the palms of Adam Zampa who gets both hands to it but still fumbles slightly. He manages to hold on though and New Zealand have lost both their openers.
Commentary.Howout: c Adam Zampa b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: Sean Abbott begins from 'round the wicket and bangs this in a touch short and into the batter. Devon Conway fends this to the left of the bowler.
Sean Abbott is into the attack now! Can he continue the good work done by Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood?

What a jaffa! Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump. The ball straightens after pitching and Kane Williamson is left playing down the wrong line. The ball swishes past the outside edge and Josh Hazlewood gives the batter the stare. Another miserly over with just one coming off it.
Goes back to bowling on a good length but strays into the pads, Devon Conway tucks this down to fine leg for a run.
This is a fraction short and outside the off stump, Devon Conway cuts this straight to the point fielder.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this full and outside the off pole, Devon Conway gets his front foot forward and leaves the ball alone.
Serves this on a good length and angling into the stumps, Devon Conway taps this back towards the bowler.

Josh Hazlewood comes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and bowls this full outside off, Devon Conway advances down the wicket and hit this wide of mid off. David Warner dives to his right and stops the ball.
Mitchell Starc goes much fuller and outside the off stump, Kane Williamson times this well but finds the mid off fielder. Just one run from this over and Australia are keeping it tight here.
This is much straighter and on a good length, Kane Williamson covers the line of the ball and blocks it down to the right of the bowler.
On a good length once again but going away from the off stump, Kane Williamson shoulders his arms to this one as well.
Angles this away from the batter from outside off on a good length, Kane Williamson raises his arms and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
This is slightly fuller and just outside off stump, Kane Williamson gets his bat down in time and taps the ball towards backward point.
Mitchell Starc serves this on a good length and gets the ball to angle into the left-hander, Devon Conway tucks this towards square leg and takes a single.

Beaten! What a delivery to end the over. Josh Hazlewood bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump, getting the ball to nip back in off the surface. Kane Williamson goes through with the shot and gets beaten on the inside edge. Maiden over for Josh Hazlewood.
Josh Hazlewood goes a touch fuller and outside the off pole, Kane Williamson strokes this towards mid off.
Continues bowling on a good length and in the outside off stump channel, Kane Williamson is solid in defense as he blocks this to the off side.
This is in line with the stump on a good length. Kane Williamson stands tall and taps this into the pitch with soft hands.
This is on a good length and just outside the off stump, Kane Williamson covers the line of the ball and blocks it back down the pitch.
Josh Hazlewood bowls this slightly fuller and angling into the pads, Kane Williamson clips this towards square leg.

Risky single to end the over! On a length, on off. Kane Williamson defends it with soft hands towards covers and sets off for a single. The fielder charges towards the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Single taken.
Back of a length, around off. Kane Williamson rides the bounce and pushes it to covers.
Quick single! On a length, on middle. Conway clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around off. Conway dabs it towards cover-point this time.
WIDE! Goes fuller an down the leg side. Conway looks to flick it but misses.
Serves it tad shorter on off. Conway dabs it towards the off side.

An appeal for an LBW again! On a length, nips back in from off. Conway tries to defend it but misses. He gets hit high on his pads and there is a big appeal again but the umpire is not interested this time.

Kane Williamson has been given out LBW here! However, he takes the DRS straightaway! The replays roll in and the Hotspot shows that there is clear bat involved here. So, the decision will be overturned and it will be NOT OUT! This delivery lands on a length, just outside off. Kane Williamson tries to defend it but gets the inside edge onto his pads. There is an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. However, Kane Williamson reviews and the decision is overturned.
Nicely placed. Shortish length, on middle. Kane clips it through mid-wicket for a couple. Good use of the wrists.
On a length and around off. Kane Williamson gets an inside edge onto the turf as he tries to defend it again.
Bowls it on a length, on off. Kane Williamson with a solid block again.
Serves it on a length, on off. Kane Williamson defends it solidly from his crease.
Back of a length, on middle. Kane Williamson clips it past square leg for a couple.

On the shorter side, angling it into the body. Conway defends it off the top half of his blade towards the leg side. This has been a good start from Australia, they have not given away anything so far.
Serves it on a length, on off. Conway with a compact forward defence.
Shortish length and outside off. Kane Williamson dabs it towards covers and takes an easy single this time.
A fullish delivery, around off. Kane Williamson stays in his crease and plays it late towards the off side.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off. Kane Williamson rides the bounce and defends it towards the off side.
Mitchell Starc bowls this on a good length and wide outside off, Kane Williamson shoulders his arms to this one.
Strays onto the pads this time on a good length, Devon Conway clips this towards deep square leg and they run well this time to take a couple of runs. Just two runs from Josh Hazlewood's first over.
Josh Hazlewood serves this on a good length and just outside off, Devon Conway blocks this towards short cover.
Goes fuller and on middle. Conway defends it towards the leg side.
Goes tad fuller and on off. Conway with a solid block again.
Serves it on a length again, on off. Conway defends it from his crease.
On a length and around off. Conway cuts it to the point fielder.
Josh Hazlewood will bowl from the other end.

Oh, comedy of errors there! After such a big mix-up Kane Williamson still survives! Starc bowls it on a length, on off and Kane Williamson pushes it to covers. He sets off for a single straightaway but Conway is hesitant at the start. However, he then responds but both batters stop again in the middle of the pitch. In the meanwhile, Sean Abbott runs towards the ball and fumbles a bit. Conway and Kane Williamson then both try to run towards the batter's end but Conway stops after seeing his captain charging towards that end. The throw is off target at the batter's end as Alex Carey collects it away from the stumps. He looks to flick it back on to the sticks but misses and Kane Williamson makes his ground in the end.
The skipper of New Zealand, Kane Williamson makes his way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! This time he is caught and Martin Guptill departs early! Starc strikes in his first over and this was just what they needed to keep their spirits high. Starc bowls this one very cleverly. Pushes it full and wider outside off. Guptill goes for a big drive away from his body. However, he only manages to get a thick outside edge and the ball goes quite quickly towards first slip. Finch takes a sharp catch and Australia celebrate.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Dropped! Bowls it full and on middle. Guptill flicks it to square leg and Marnus Labuschagne there jumps to catch it. He gets both hands on this one but the ball does not stick and two runs are taken as the ball goes towards deep square leg.
That's a natural variation for the left-arm seamer! Bowls it full and outside off. It goes across the batter and Guptill leaves it alone.
Bowls it fuller on middle. Guptill flicks it to the square leg fielder this time. This is good from Starc, targeting the stumps straightaway!
Starc starts off with a length delivery on middle. Swinging into Guptill and he clips it to mid-wicket.
